behavior_verified: Download and build choices display only their own fields, preserve per-method drafts, and use native radio keyboard behavior.
A failed preparation and its exact Kun run, conversation/trace link, candidate and offline/smoke results share one source card.
A submitted auto handoff is not proof of an active or successful repair. Terminal unverified repairs remain attention states and permit an explicit manual retry.
Kun-repaired images count as prepared only with a verified maintenance candidate and matching successful offline/smoke evidence; task completion alone is insufficient.
Source mismatches are not merged; missing-source repairs and unmatched image checks remain visible without counting as prepared.
Ambiguous manual responses reuse request identity. A late response after close/reopen preserves new inputs, joins the accepted repair and prevents duplicate submission.
Open logs, reading offsets, disclosure choices and focus survive polling.
Failed downloads offer source/retry actions and never implicitly submit local builds or Kun build-repair authorization.
The administrator repair-list lookup is strict, source scoped, capped at 20, deterministically time ordered and read-only.
validation_notes: An interrupted initial Go invocation is retained separately and not counted as a pass. The complete serial rerun passed.
Browser review caught optional log nodes rendered as literal null; guarded appends and final DOM/browser assertions verified the fix.

Final Go source was stable for the complete suite and vet. Subsequent initialization-only refinements were checked with targeted suites, final embedded-asset tests, fresh platform builds and the final browser workflow.
limits: No deployment to the user server or real Docker image build, model, vLLM, GPU or production Kun acceptance run.
The browser uses the actual isolated Go demo service with explicitly controlled preparation/repair API fixtures; it checks UI behavior rather than autonomous repair quality.
The public image catalog still requires real publisher-provided image references; this release does not publish Docker images.
Only the Docker setup browser workflow was rerun here; previous releases retain their original broader browser evidence.
